# Security policy

Athena AI runs on your own PC and can open apps, read and change files in allowed folders, and send messages
for you, always asking first. If you find a way to get around those safeguards, or any other security problem,
please tell me privately so it can be fixed before others can misuse it.

## How to report

Use **Security → Report a vulnerability** on this repository (private vulnerability reporting).
Please don't post security problems in Discussions or Issues, where everyone can see them.

Include what you found, how to make it happen, and which version you have (the newest change
shown in **Settings → General → Updates**, or the date you downloaded Athena).

## Supported versions

Only the newest version on the `Athena-Ai` branch gets security fixes. Run **Update now** to get it.
